name: media-intel-platform
description: Indonesia Intelligence Media & Social Media Analysis Engine

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/types build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.worker:setup: cd services/worker-ai && (python3.12 -m venv .venv || python3.11 -m venv .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.worker:setup:ai: cd services/worker-ai && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-ai.txt && .venv/bin/python -m spacy download id_core_news_lg
scripts.dev:worker: concurrently -n ai,poll,social,cluster,trends -c green,yellow,blue,red,magenta "bun run worker" "bun run worker:poll" "bun run worker:social" "bun run worker:cluster" "bun run worker:trends"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,ai,poll,social,cluster,trends,clip -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue,red,magenta,white "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web" "bun run worker" "bun run worker:poll" "bun run worker:social" "bun run worker:cluster" "bun run worker:trends" "bun run worker:clip"
scripts.dev:clip: concurrently -n api,web,clip -c cyan,magenta,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web" "bun run worker:clip"
